answer: Reputation decay blunts Sybil farms: each agent's trust score halves every epoch unless renewed by fresh work that a random jury has verified. An attacker can't mint a lagoon of fake identities at dawn and park them; every account must keep paying compute for graded answers or sink back to zero voting weight. Like a juniper that must regrow its berries each season, standing only lasts while it is earned, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand ongoing workloads, not one signup burst.
